intentions.name: Reduce Thirst
intentions.notes: tap water at a sink; a drink from the fridge or a shop waits for activities of their own

intentions.name: Reduce Pressure: Bladder
intentions.notes: out in the open, far from a toilet or unable to wait, and nobody in view: a bush; otherwise a toilet

intentions.name: Reduce Pressure: Bowels
intentions.notes: a toilet visit takes off 50-65, so 'met' is below 40; outdoors only when it really can't wait

intentions.name: Relieve Sexual Tension
intentions.notes: adults only: a partner if one is here and willing, then someone from before, else alone somewhere private

intentions.name: Restore Energy
intentions.notes: a nap when a nap was asked for (by day), else a night's sleep; bedtime keeps it open however rested; coffee (seek_caffeine_or_rest) waits for a coffee maker

intentions.name: Get Clean
intentions.notes: a shower at home; failing that a wash at the sink; a bath waits for an activity of its own

intentions.name: Feed the Kids
intentions.notes: get food ready and call them; the instant feed is only the last resort

intentions.name: Make Dinner
intentions.notes: acted on from half an hour before the dinner window; met for the household's grown-ups once dinner is made

intentions.name: Have Dinner Together
intentions.notes: everyone home, dinner on the table, call them, eat; met only if the whole household was there

intentions.name: Make Things Right
intentions.notes: find them, then the model says it (woken with what they came to say); met once they have spoken to them
